mission: Produce NEW, verified knowledge that lets ENGINE evolve -- the indicator to its next version, the strategy and the research loop itself -- as time passes. FORWARD, never backward. Admin directive 2026-09-15: do NOT re-chew what is already proven (bot, strategy, indicator have been proven many times). Re-deriving a settled law is useless spam. Every study must take a PROVEN finding as its floor and produce the NEXT step engine can TEST and fold into a version bump. The agents are hypothesis-GENERATORS + synthesizers feeding engine's evolution; engine tests candidates on real data and the good ones advance the fleet. Output is a ranked queue of 'things engine should test next', not conclusions.
output_contract: Each finding is a CANDIDATE FOR ENGINE, tagged [FOR-ENGINE], stating: (1) the proven floor it builds on, (2) the NEW hypothesis/method, (3) a concrete engine-runnable TEST + expected result, (4) why it could ADVANCE a version. Weak/re-derivation/off-lane candidates are dropped, not posted.

gates.G1_FORWARD: Builds PAST a proven finding toward something engine has NOT yet tested. Re-deriving or restating a settled result FAILS -- that is the useless-spam gate.
gates.G2_TESTABLE: Names a concrete test engine can run on real data/backtests, with an expected result, so a candidate can be proven or killed.
gates.G3_VERIFIED: Survived adversarial peer verification (>= majority HOLDS; default REFUTED when thin or when it is just a plausible-sounding restatement).
gates.G4_ADVANCES: If verified AND the test passes, it plausibly advances a fleet version (indicator fan-M.m.p, a strategy lever, or the research loop). No version-path = park it.

tiers.name: HYPOTHESIS
tiers.bar: a forward candidate built on a proven floor

tiers.name: TESTABLE

tiers.name: QUEUED
tiers.bar: handed to engine as a [FOR-ENGINE] test candidate

tiers.name: FOLDED
tiers.bar: engine ran the test; if it passed, folded into the next version -> new frontier opens

seed_nodes.proven:
The fan sp-path is 96-98% predetermined; every PRICE-derived add-on to it has now failed on money (4 layers closed).

DEAD - auto-REJECT (measured on real money by engine's storm agents, 2026-09-17): generic TA on price (RSI/EMA/MACD lookbacks, ATR or trailing stops, volatility-scaled position sizing, Bollinger, LSTM/GNN/transformer price models, sentiment, 'memory graph' / 'learned patterns'); re-weighting our existing signals by conviction or confidence; adding sublayers / age-compounding / re-centering / cross-quality seeding to the fan; shrinkage or conditional significance lenses (bayes_sharpe, CFA) at our slot counts n<=24 - naive BH-FDR is at the ceiling. Proposing any of these again = REJECTED.
seed_nodes.frontier: NEW DATA, not new math on price. Name ONE input we do not use yet - funding rate, open interest, liquidation-cascade prints, or order-book imbalance at our TP levels - that could tell the counter-fade WHEN an sp-extreme is exhausted. Give the exact field, its free public source (Binance/Bybit REST), how it joins our bar series, and a test on our hof slots with a pass gate.
